messages:
maria: FYI — customer reported that our JSON/structured output has started failing after a model fallback. Their consumer parser errors with 'unexpected token' when parsing items.

maria: Customer payload (redacted):
```
Request: POST /v1/generate
{
  "model": "gpt-large",
  "json_mode": true,
  "routing": "smart",
  "prompt": "..."
}

Response (what customer received):
{
  "status": "ok",
  "items": "[{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"foo\"},{\"id\":2,\"name\":\"bar\"}]"
}
```

maria: Notice items is a stringified JSON array instead of an actual array — their strict parser fails. They say it worked earlier this morning.

sam: Thanks @maria — can you share customer id and example request_id? do we have logs showing a fallback to a different variant? :eyes:

maria: customer id ACME_CORP, request id 20250312-9a1f. Logs show fallback to "gpt-large-quantized-8bit"

ingrid: possibly the quantized variant's response formatting step added extra quoting, we've seen tokenization differences cause template wrappers. Quick check: did they include streaming=true? streaming can sometimes insert framing. 

sam: repro attempt from my laptop (non-production):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","json_mode":true,"routing":"smart","prompt":"return JSON array of items"}'
```

sam: when I force routing to "variant:gpt-large-quantized-8bit" I get the stringified items. When I pin routing:"gpt-large" I get an actual JSON array. 

ingrid: ok this matches. Root cause: fallback path doesn't enforce structured-serialization contract. Some variants wrap the whole payload in a single string when they hit generation heuristics. We'll push a guard in the router that validates the top-level JSON types before returning.

alex: Product note — we need a registry flag like "structured_safe": true on catalog models so smart routing avoids variants that don't preserve JSON types. Also add a breaking-change alert in console for customers using json_mode + smart routing.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-2749 and linked to oncall. Priority P1 for customers on Dedicated. :bell:

maria: Customer is on Dedicated and it's impacting ingestion. Escalating to P1. Please triage.

ingrid: I'm dropping a small hotfix that validates if json_mode=true then we deserialize/inspect response and if it's a quoted JSON string we attempt to parse and re-emit proper types and add metric. Deploying now.

sam: workaround for customers: set routing to "strict" or pin model variant in request until fix lands. Also set streaming=false if they can tolerate.

maria: thanks. I'll update the customer and include repro curl + mitigation. :thumbsup:
